prompt: Young xianxia scribe, small human in a plain pale-blue robe with wide sleeves, black hair tied in a topknot, calm face. In the RIGHT hand a very wide flat calligraphy brush held up and forward with a dark ink-tipped head; under the LEFT arm a rolled paper scroll with a red seal ribbon (asymmetric). Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chibi large head, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands still and breathes gently, chest and sleeves rising slightly and falling; the wide brush stays held in the same right hand and the rolled seal scroll stays under the other arm, both clearly visible

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, breathes gently; the wide brush stays held in his right hand on the viewer's left, the scroll with the red seal stays under his other arm on the viewer's right
direction_prompts.west: facing left, breathes gently; the wide brush stays held in front of him pointing left, the scroll stays under his arm
direction_prompts.north: back to the viewer, breathes gently; the wide brush stays visible in his right hand on the viewer's right side, the scroll stays under the other arm
direction_prompts.east: facing right, breathes gently, upright and standing like the front view; the long wide brush is held low in front of him pointing right and down, a dark brush head clearly visible in EVERY frame, never lost (second attempt, east only)

east_take1.prompt: facing right, breathes gently; the wide brush stays held in front of him pointing right, the scroll stays under his arm
east_take1.why: brush lost in every frame, ghostly pose

west_regeneration.prompt: facing left, breathes gently, upright and standing like the front view; the long wide brush is held low in front of him pointing left and down, a dark brush head clearly visible in EVERY frame (second attempt, west only)
west_regeneration.why: brush lost, worse than take 1; take 1 kept

interact.action_description: lifts the wide brush a little forward and up as if about to write a stamp mark, then lowers it; the brush always stays in the same right hand and clearly visible; the scroll stays under the other arm

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, lifts the wide brush in his right hand (the viewer's left side) slightly forward and up, then lowers; the brush never crosses to the viewer's right
direction_prompts.west: facing left, holds the wide brush out in front toward the left a little higher, then lowers it; brush stays on the left
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, his right arm is on the viewer's RIGHT; the wide brush is held in that right hand beside his body, clearly visible to the right of his back in EVERY frame, raised slightly then lowered; nothing is held on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.east: facing right, holds the wide brush out in front toward the right a little higher, then lowers it; brush stays on the right and does not rise above his head
